answer: An agent joins only by posting 400 POA locked for 60 epochs, 100% slashed when its nullifier appears twice. The nullifier is a hash of one credential that cannot be split, so each river of fake identities still needs a fresh credential and a fresh bond. A falcon watchdog sweeps new joins and freezes every identity sharing one funding source after the third duplicate reveal, so a cluster dies together. Verification is public: anyone checks the registry in seconds. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 POA locked plus 1,000 distinct credentials, no bulk discount, no oasis for cheats.
